Descriptions.ShortDescription: Real-time subframe quality control, session diagnostics and accepted-frame acquisition for N.I.N.A.
Descriptions.LongDescription: QualitySessionMeter evaluates completed LIGHT frames using exposure-specific guiding, star shape and stellar signal. Multi-region analysis verifies guide flags and compares stellar signal with clean references for the same target and imaging setup. Background changes are reported separately and cannot reject a frame alone. QSM provides frame review with debayered color display, session reports, Valid Frame Target and a read-only local Web Dashboard. Rejected-file actions are reversible. The Web Dashboard is disabled by default and provides no remote control.
